thread:
jen: Kicking off a config-only deploy to tighten batching + lower conn timeout for realtime routes. Canary 10% in us-west1. Watch p95/p99, 5xx and memory for 20m. Pin variant: v2.1.4-compact.
deploy-bot: Rollout started (canary-id: can-1743216789). Applying config diff to 10% of realtime hosts.
sam: ACK. I'll watch the dashboards (latency, 5xx, queue depth). Flag me on any spikes.
maria: Quick note — add fallback to async tier if queue depth > 80 to avoid tail latency.
jen: Added fallback rule. Config diff below: 
```yaml
routes:
  realtime:
    batch_max_tokens: 256
    batch_max_requests: 16
    conn_idle_timeout_ms: 1200
    fallback_route: async-lowlatency
rollout:
  canary_pct: 10
  region: us-west1
  rollback_on:
    - p95_latency_increase_pct>20
    - five_xx_rate>0.5
```
ops-bot: Alert policy auto-update: muting infra flapper alerts for first 10m of this rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary live at 10% (can-1743216789). Observation window 20m starting now.
sam: seeing a slight p95 uptick at minute 6 on canary hosts, about +8% vs baseline — staying below the 20% threshold.
maria: one canary pod memory to ~78%, no OOMs. Queue depth fine. continuing to monitor.
jen: If no 5xx and p95 stays < baseline+15% we'll ramp to 50% in 10m. Otherwise we roll back and pin to v2.1.3.
deploy-bot: Scheduled ramp to 50% at +10m (auto). Will abort if rollback conditions hit.
sam: Rollback playbook prepped (cmds + tag revert). Ready to execute if needed.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/tinybatch-rollback (internal).
jen: Thanks team — keep calls short, post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
